```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    vals = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)

    # Each adjacent equal diagonal pair marks a diagonal to extend.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                r2, c2 = r + dr, c + dc
                if not (0 <= r2 < h and 0 <= c2 < w and grid[r2][c2] == color):
                    continue

                # Compare the clear continuation beyond each end of the pair.
                rays = [(r - dr, c - dc, -dr, -dc),
                        (r2 + dr, c2 + dc, dr, dc)]
                counts = []
                for rr, cc, sr, sc in rays:
                    n = 0
                    while (0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w
                           and out[rr][cc] == bg):
                        n += 1
                        rr += sr
                        cc += sc
                    counts.append(n)

                k = 0 if counts[0] > counts[1] else 1
                rr, cc, sr, sc = rays[k]
                while (0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w
                       and out[rr][cc] == bg):
                    out[rr][cc] = color
                    rr += sr
                    cc += sc
    return out
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)

    # Find maximal diagonal runs of identical non-background cells.
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == bg:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r - dr, c - dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue

                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue

                # Compare empty space beyond the two ends; extend on the
                # side with more room, preferring the forward side on ties.
                ends = [
                    (run[0][0] - dr, run[0][1] - dc, -dr, -dc),
                    (run[-1][0] + dr, run[-1][1] + dc, dr, dc),
                ]
                lengths = []
                for rr, cc, sr, sc in ends:
                    n = 0
                    while (0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w
                           and grid[rr][cc] == bg):
                        n += 1
                        rr += sr
                        cc += sc
                    lengths.append(n)

                side = 1 if lengths[1] >= lengths[0] else 0
                rr, cc, sr, sc = ends[side]
                for _ in range(lengths[side]):
                    out[rr][cc] = color
                    rr += sr
                    cc += sc

    return out
```
